skill.name: gmgn-kline-pattern
skill.description: Analyzes GMGN token candle data, classifies price-action patterns, and produces a transparent 0-100 score from six defined measurements.
skill.summary: Classify token candle patterns and explain every scoring adjustment.
skill.author: gmgnai

security_audit.summary: Five findings confirm bounded external command use for GMGN setup and candle retrieval. The remaining static alerts are Markdown, formulas, defensive examples, and negative secret references, but the API key setup can expose credentials through arguments or output.

remediation.issue: The API key is supplied as a command-line argument and configuration output is displayed.
remediation.suggestion: Use an interactive hidden prompt or standard input, redact configuration output, and never place the API key in arguments, logs, or chat.

remediation.issue: The skill installs and runs third-party global CLI tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited gmgn-cli version, document package provenance, and request confirmation before installation or configuration changes.

content.value_statement: Raw candle data makes token trends difficult to assess consistently. This skill calculates six measurements, classifies the pattern, and explains a reproducible 0-100 score.
actual_capabilities: Fetches read-only candle data for supported Solana and EVM token addresses through gmgn-cli.
Validates token address shape and restricts resolution to documented values.
Calculates trend, slope, volatility, drawdown, volume ratio, and distance from the range low.
Classifies candles into eleven ordered price-action patterns.
Produces a 0-100 score with every applied adjustment listed.
Reports unavailable measurements and skips dependent scoring rules.
limitations: Requires gmgn-cli and a configured GMGN API key.
Describes historical price action and does not predict future prices.
Does not assess contract safety, holder distribution, sentiment, or token identity.
Simplified averages can differ from EMA, regression, or ATR-based tools near turning points.

use_cases.title: Review a Token Chart
use_cases.description: Classify recent candles and receive a transparent strength score before deeper research.

use_cases.title: Standardize Market Notes
use_cases.description: Apply the same measurements and thresholds across recurring token reviews.

use_cases.title: Explain Price Action
use_cases.description: Show learners how trend, volatility, volume, and drawdown contribute to a pattern label.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Pattern Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [token address] on [chain] using [resolution]. Name the current pattern and show the score.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a quick, structured candle review.

prompt_templates.title: Measurement Breakdown
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [token address] on [chain] at [resolution]. Explain all six measurements and each score adjustment in simple language.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the calculation details matter.

prompt_templates.title: Risk Context Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [token address] on [chain] at [resolution]. Emphasize drawdown, volatility, volume context, unavailable measurements, and skipped scoring rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use to inspect uncertainty and historical downside context.

prompt_templates.title: Full Rule Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [token address] on [chain] at [resolution]. Apply pattern rules in order, verify arithmetic, list every score delta, and state limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an auditable advanced analysis.

output_examples.input: Analyze a BSC token at 15-minute resolution.
output_examples.output: Pattern: Uptrend channel. Score: 76 of 100. Positive slope and bullish short-term structure support the score, while elevated volatility adds caution.

output_examples.input: Check whether a Solana token is breaking down on hourly candles.
output_examples.output: Pattern: Breakdown. Score: 23 of 100. Deep drawdown, negative slope, and a volume-backed red candle explain the weak reading.

output_examples.input: Review a flat token with missing recent volume.
output_examples.output: Pattern: Sideways consolidation. Volume ratio is unavailable because the denominator is zero, so volume-dependent rules are skipped and disclosed.

best_practices: Provide the chain, complete token address, and one supported candle resolution.
Treat the score as a historical summary and combine it with independent contract and holder research.
Review all six measurements and skipped rules before interpreting the pattern label.
anti_patterns: Do not submit malformed addresses or append commands, URLs, or unrelated text.
Do not interpret the score as a buy, sell, or price prediction.
Do not use this skill for contract safety, holder analysis, or trade execution.

faq.question: Which chains are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents Solana, BSC, Base, and Ethereum, subject to gmgn-cli support.

faq.question: Which candle resolutions can I request?
Does the score predict future price?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes historical candle structure and is not investment advice.

faq.question: How much data is required?
faq.answer: At least eight usable candles must remain after validation. Some measurements use longer windows when available.

faq.question: What happens when a measurement cannot be calculated?
faq.answer: The result marks it unavailable and skips every scoring rule that depends on it.

faq.question: Can it assess token safety or holders?
faq.answer: No. It only analyzes price candles and directs those questions to separate specialized skills.
